statement: xpad uses legacy evdev BTN_A, BTN_B, BTN_X, BTN_Y and BTN_TL, BTN_TR, BTN_MODE, BTN_START, BTN_SELECT, BTN_THUMBL/THUMBR; its 360 packet decoder maps face bits data[3] bits 4/5/6/7 to those event codes, with X/Y specifically BTN_X/BTN_Y rather than generic HID Button usage ordinals.

applicability.scope: xpad.c 420-450, 913-928, 1979-1987. Legacy Linux code aliases are part of xpad consumer contract; no claim of hardware-scancode equivalence.
